findings.desc: doc-code-drift: verification_evidence_refresh_stale help text and workflow guides still describe pre-fix semantics. packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:479 description is unchanged: "Refresh HEAD/material hashes for stale verificationEvidence (rerun command)" -- it was NOT updated even though plan.md CHK-002 step 4 explicitly says to adjust this command help text. Per the new checklist.ts behavior (lines ~1063-1075), refresh_stale now REFUSES any stale row with a non-empty command + result:pass (leaves it stale, prints a refusal message) and only re-stamps command-less attestation rows -- it never reruns anything. The live help text still implies a rerun-then-refresh workflow. docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md:195 and :278 and docs/requirements/decisions/testing-infra.md:166 repeat the same stale workflow: "after re-running the corresponding verification command, drop dryRun to refresh the metadata" / "it only refreshes ... does not prove the test actually ran, so the command in the dry-run output should be re-run first." Under the new code this instructed workflow no longer works for command-backed pass rows: calling refresh_stale (even after manually re-running the command) will always be refused; the correct new path is verification_evidence_add with a fresh result, not refresh_stale. Severity high: this is a live, user-facing command-description/workflow-doc mismatch with the exact behavior this story intentionally changed.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 630b6d9: updated command-catalog.ts help, evidence-stale-hint.ts recovery block, story-lifecycle.md (x2) and testing-infra.md to state that refresh_stale refuses command-backed result:pass rows (re-run + re-record via verification_evidence_add) and only re-stamps command-less attestation.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: CHK-002 plan.md mechanism step 4 promises "Adjust the summary line + the command help (\"(rerun command)\")" so documented refresh_stale semantics match the new honest behavior. Only the in-code per-row/summary lines (packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts:1074,1103) were updated. Two other surfaces still describe the OLD blanket-refresh concept verbatim: (1) packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:479 tool description literally reads "Refresh HEAD/material hashes for stale verificationEvidence (rerun command)" -- the ONLY text an agent sees via `lattice help`/`--help`/MCP tool listing, unchanged, with no mention that command-backed pass rows are now refused; (2) packages/main/src/core/evidence-stale-hint.ts renderEvidenceStaleHint (lines ~88-112) whose "Run to recover: lattice verification_evidence_refresh_stale" block is asserted byte-identical across packages/main/src/handlers/session.ts, packages/main/src/handlers/hints.ts, packages/main/src/handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts (pinned by packages/main/src/tasks/verification-freshness-smoke.ts) and shown to every agent that hits EVIDENCE STALE -- still instructs the recovery recipe unconditionally, with no caveat that command-backed pass rows will be refused and require re-running via verification_evidence_add first. This leaves the pre-fix concept ("refresh_stale generically recovers stale evidence") as residual, misleading guidance on exactly the surfaces meant to prevent false evidence beliefs -- the core goal of this story.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 630b6d9: the concept lane additionally named core/evidence-stale-hint.ts renderEvidenceStaleHint (byte-identical across session/hints/transition-orchestrator, pinned by verification-freshness-smoke) — its 'Run to recover' header now carries the command-backed-refusal caveat, keeping the block line-count and cross-surface byte-identicality intact (verified: the pinned byte-identical assertions pass).

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: all 4 refresh_stale surfaces (command-catalog.ts, story-lifecycle.md x3, testing-infra.md, evidence-stale-hint.ts) still describe the pre-B-1507 blanket 'REFUSED / never re-executes' narrative that RP-010 correctly attested at 2026-07-26T11:14-11:23. Since then, main's B-1507 merged into story/B-3b88 (commit f13af54181, 2026-07-26T12:33:50) added pinned-command re-execution to writeStaleRefresh/verification_evidence_refresh_stale, and a same-story regression fix (73ff9cf478, 2026-07-26T23:24:14, 'restore unconditional command-backed-pass demotion in refresh') clarified the exact non-pin fallback. Current delivered semantics (packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts writeStaleRefresh + async verification_evidence_refresh_stale handler) is now two-branch, neither branch matching the docs: (a) when the row's intent carries a `.verification` pin, the pinned command is RE-EXECUTED via enforceAndStampEvidence/runSingleAllowlistedCommand; on a real pass the row is re-stamped as a fresh mechanical:true COVERED receipt bound to current head/material -- not refused, no manual re-add needed; (b) when there is no pin, the pin command is unavailable, or the re-run does not pass, ANY command-backed result:pass row reaching the write path is unconditionally DEMOTED in place to mechanical:false with an explicit nonMechanicalReason audit string -- the row IS rewritten with fresh head/material hashes, it is not left untouched/'refused'. None of the surfaces below reflect either branch: all say a stale command-backed result:pass row 'is REFUSED'/'is refused', and two explicitly claim it 'never re-executes', which is false whenever a verification pin exists. Locations: packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:491 (verification_evidence_refresh_stale description: '...command-backed result:pass rows are refused and must be re-run + re-recorded via verification_evidence_add (never silently re-certified)'); docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md:195 ('...REFUSED (never silently re-certified) — re-run its command and re-record...'); story-lifecycle.md:265 (TEST-phase tool table row: '...is refused and must be re-run + re-recorded...'); story-lifecycle.md:278 ('It never re-executes, so a stale command-backed result:pass row is REFUSED rather than re-certified...'); docs/requirements/decisions/testing-infra.md:166 (same TEST-phase table wording); packages/main/src/core/evidence-stale-hint.ts:87-88 JSDoc example AND :107-108 the actual live renderer string shown to callers who hit stale evidence (both: 'a command-backed result:pass is REFUSED — re-run it and re-record via verification_evidence_add'). evidence-stale-hint.ts is especially load-bearing since its renderer output is the literal remediation text a caller sees at runtime, and it steers toward a manual re-run+re-add workflow even on rows the tool would already auto-re-execute via the pin, while mischaracterizing the safety fallback as blanket refusal rather than an auditable in-place demotion. Same category/file-set as resolved F-001/F-003/F-004; reopened by the later B-1507 merge + regression fix landing after those docs were written. Repo-wide sweep (grep 'refresh_stale' across *.md/*.ts outside .worktrees/dist/node_modules) found no other live description carrying the stale wording; B-1507's own plan.md and refresh-stale-honesty-smoke.ts already correctly describe the pin-reexecution behavior, confirming these 4 files are the only remaining drifted surfaces.
